calibration.method: unscrambled Sobol' quadrature, no seed: delta from the selection points (indices 1 to 2^points), false-alarm rates from the validation points (indices 2^points + 1 to 2^(points + 1) - 1), a disjoint deterministic set per cell; rates are estimates at the evaluated cells

excludes: cells between the evaluated cells and the continuous box (the maximum over cells is read at the evaluated cells only, and is biased upward by taking a maximum of noisy rates)
the model: the response, the dispersion phi and the readout covariance as planned
validation.interval: 95 percent exact binomial (Clopper-Pearson) interval of the validation counts, which treats the quasi-Monte-Carlo points as independent draws: approximate

power.note: rates at the listed truths with block error estimates; no bound over the claimed region

rule.boxes_note: the fitting box of a and s equals the calibrated null box; a fit on a bound reads out of domain
rule.primary: departure of the marked probabilities of mark 101 from the geometric law toward a plane rotation eps

model: exact noisy density matrix of the committed circuits: depolarizing PRX and CZ, ASAP idle T1/T2, herald-conditioned readout; no coherent error, leakage or crosstalk
